name: procarbazine
uses: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE MATULANE is indicated for use in combination with other anticancer drugs for the treatment of Stage III or Stage IV Hodgkin Lymphoma. MATULANE is an alkylating drug indicated for use in combination with other anticancer drugs for the treatment of Stage III or Stage IV Hodgkin Lymphoma. ( 1 )
pediatric: 8.4 Pediatric Use Tremors, coma, and convulsions have occurred in pediatric patients treated with MATULANE. Pediatric patients should be closely monitored. Individualize the dosage based on the incidence and severity of adverse reactions [ see Dosage and Administration (2.2) ] .
contra: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS MATULANE is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity or anaphylaxis to the drug or drug components [see Adverse Reactions (6) ] . History of known hypersensitivity or anaphylaxis to the drug or drug components ( 4 )
interactions: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Central nervous system depressants: monitor signs and symptoms of neurotoxicity. ( 7.1 ) Monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitors: avoid MAO inhibitors and other drugs with MAO inhibition activity within two weeks before and during treatment with MATULANE. ( 7.2 ) Alcohol: avoid consumption of alcohol or products containing propylene glycol before, after, and during therapy with MATULANE. ( 7.3 ) Tyramine-containing foods: avoid concomitant use. ( 7.4 ) 7.1 Central Nervous System Depressants Monitor signs and symptoms of neurotoxicity with concomitant use of MATULANE and other central nervous system (CNS) depressing agents. Concomitant use of MATULANE with other CNS depressing agents may result in potentiation of CNS depression with MATULANE. 7.2 Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors Avoid monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitors and other drugs with MAO inhibition activity within two weeks before, and during treatment with MATULANE. MATULANE exhibits MAO inhibitory activity. Concomitant use of MATULANE with other MAO inhibitors may increase the risk of a hypertensive crisis. 7.3 Alcohol Avoid consumption of alcohol or products containing propylene glycol before, after, and during therapy with MATULANE [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3) ]. Use of MATULANE is associated with a disulfiram-like reaction to alcohol, including abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, headaches, and flushing. 7.4 Tyramine-containing Foods Avoid tyramine-containing foods during therapy with MATULANE. Concurrent ingestion of foods rich in tyramine may cause sudden and severe high blood pressure in patients receiving MATULANE.
